जनिेि िारी करना 7. जनयम 18 का उप-जनयम (4) दकसी भी व्य जि या व्य जियों के िगि को नागर जिमानन अपेक्षाएं (सीएआर) िीर्िक से जििेर् जनिेिों के प्र चालन से छूट िेना। [फा. सं. ए िी/25/2023-डी िी] िोजभत गुप्ता ,संयुि सजचि MINISTRY OF CIVIL AVIATION NOTIFICATION New Delhi, the 10th February, 2026 S.O. 710(E).— In pursuance of sub-section (4) of section 3 of the Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024 (16 of 2024), the Central Government hereby authorises the officers specified in column (1) of the First Schedule annexed hereto to exercise such of the powers of the Director General of Civil Aviation (more specifically described in the Second Schedule annexed hereto) as are specified in the corresponding entries in column (2) of the said First Schedule. -- 2 of 3 -- [भाग II—खण्ड 3(ii)] भारत का रािपत्र : असाधारण 3 FIRST SCHEDULE S. No. Designation of the Officer Powers in the Second Schedule to be exercised (1) (2) (3) 1. Joint Director General of Civil Aviation All 2. Deputy Director General of Civil Aviation 1,2,3,4,5,6 3. Director of Operations, Radio Telephone Operator (Restricted) Division 1,2,3,4,5,6 4. Director of Airworthiness 1 5. Deputy Director of Operations, Radio Telephone Operator (Restricted) Division 5 SECOND SCHEDULE S.No. Rule of the Radio Telephone Operator (Restricted) Certificate and Licence Rules, 2025 by which power is conferred Nature of Power (1) (2) (3) 1. sub-rule (2) of rule 8 To appoint invigilators for written examination of the Radio Telephone Operator (Restricted) Certificate and Licence. 2. sub-rule (2) of rule 8 To appoint invigilators for practical examination of the Radio Telephone Operator (Restricted) Certificate and Licence 3. sub-rule (3) of rule 8 To authorise examiners for practical examination of the Radio Telephone Operator (Restricted) Certificate and Licence. 4. second proviso to sub-rule (4) of rule 8 To exempt the applicants from written examination 5. sub-rule (2) of rule 14 To issue duplicate Radio Telephone Operator (Restricted) Certificate and Licence or variation in an existing Radio Telephone Operator (Restricted) Certificate and Licence. 6. sub-rule (1) of rule 18 To issue special directions titled Civil Aviation Requirements (CAR) 7. sub-rule (4) of rule 18 To exempt any person or class of persons from the operation of the special directions titled Civil Aviation Requirements (CAR) [F. No. AV/25/2023-DG] SHOBHIT GUPTA, Jt. Secy.
